description: This file defines event handling related to PDF page and graphics events within the PdfSharp library. It includes enums for event types, event argument classes, delegate types for event handlers, and a class `DocumentEvents` that encapsulates various PDF page and graphics events such as page creation, removal, graphics creation, and drawing actions.

classes.name: PageEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for changes in the PDF pages of a document, including the affected page, index, and event type.

classes.name: PageGraphicsEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for actions on a page’s XGraphics object, including the page, graphics object, and action type.

classes.name: DocumentEvents
classes.description: A container class that encapsulates various events related to PDF pages and graphics, such as page added, removed, graphics created, and drawing actions.

methods.name: OnPageAdded
methods.description: Raises the event when a page is added to the document.

methods.name: OnPageRemoved
methods.description: Raises the event when a page is removed from the document.

methods.name: OnPageGraphicsCreated
methods.description: Raises the event when the XGraphics object for a page is created.

methods.name: OnPageGraphicsAction
methods.description: Raises the event when an action is performed on a page's XGraphics object, such as drawing.
